items.context: Painful, tender lump on the upper lid margin for three days.

img.author: Andre Riemann (cropped)
img.alt: Close view of an eye with a red, swollen upper lid and a small yellow pus point at the lash line.

items.why: A tender red swelling pointing at the lash line: an infected eyelash follicle or gland.
items.pearl: Most styes settle with warm compresses in a week or two. A painless lump that lingers is more likely a chalazion.

items.context: Back from a day at the cricket. Hot, tight and tender by evening.

img.author: CDC/ R. Turnball
img.alt: An arm with bright red skin ending in a sharp straight line on the upper arm.

items.why: Uniform redness that stops at a sharp line where clothing covered the skin.
items.pearl: Sunburn peaks 12–24 hours after exposure. In Australia, sun protection is needed whenever the UV index is 3 or above.

img.author: CDC/ Division of Vector-Borne Diseases Rickettsial Zoonoses Branch (cropped)
img.alt: A small dark eight-legged creature embedded in the skin of an ankle above a folded-down sock.

items.why: A small dark body with legs, firmly embedded by its mouthparts.
items.pearl: In Australia, the advice is 'freeze it, don't squeeze it': an ether spray kills the tick before removal, which may lower the risk of allergic reactions.

items.context: Sore spots on the palms a week after a cold sore.

img.author: CDC/ Dr. N.J. Fiumara
img.alt: A palm covered in round red lesions, many with a darker centre and paler ring.

items.why: Target lesions with a dark centre and concentric rings, favouring the hands.
items.pearl: Herpes simplex is the most common trigger. Unlike hives, the lesions stay put for a week or more.

items.context: Dark lines under two fingernails in a woman with fever and aching muscles.

img.author: CDC/ Dr. Thomas F. Sellers; Emory University
img.alt: Two fingertips with tiny dark red-brown lines running lengthways under the nails.

items.why: Tiny dark red streaks running lengthways in the nail bed.
items.pearl: Minor trauma is the commonest cause. Endocarditis, vasculitis and trichinosis (in this case) are the ones not to miss.

items.context: Grew up drinking water from a deep bore with very high fluoride.

img.author: CDC (cropped)
img.alt: Teeth with mottled white and brown patches and streaks in the enamel.

items.why: Mottled white and brown enamel from too much fluoride while the teeth were forming.
items.pearl: It only happens while teeth are developing, in early childhood. Australia's fluoridated tap water is set well below the levels that cause this.

items.context: An itchy, wandering red line on the foot after a beach holiday in Thailand.

img.author: CDC (cropped)
img.alt: The top of a foot with thin, raised, wiggly red tracks.

items.why: Raised, itchy, serpiginous tracks that creep a few millimetres to centimetres a day.
items.pearl: Dog and cat hookworm larvae from sand can't get past human skin, so they wander. One dose of ivermectin or albendazole fixes it.

items.context: A painless brown patch on the palm after a trip to coastal Brazil.

img.author: CDC/ Dr. Lucille K. Georg (cropped)
img.alt: A palm with a flat, irregular, light brown patch.

items.why: A flat, painless brown patch on the palm that scrapes positive for fungus.
items.pearl: Caused by Hortaea werneckii in warm coastal regions. A skin scraping spares people an unneeded melanoma excision.

items.context: A stressed student who smokes, with painful bleeding gums and bad breath.

img.author: CDC/ Minnesota Department of Health, R.N. Barr Library; Librarians Melissa Rethlefsen and Marie Jones (cropped)
img.alt: Gums with red, swollen margins and eroded tips between the front teeth.

items.why: Painful, bleeding gums with punched-out, cratered tips between the teeth.
items.pearl: Once called 'trench mouth'. Debridement, chlorhexidine and metronidazole work; consider HIV testing if it's severe.

items.context: Itchy toe webs under a Wood's lamp.

img.author: CDC/ Dr. Lucille K. Georg
img.alt: Toe web under ultraviolet light showing a bright coral-pink glow.

items.why: Coral-red fluorescence under a Wood's lamp from porphyrins made by Corynebacterium minutissimum.
items.pearl: Tinea doesn't fluoresce this way and Pseudomonas glows green, so a Wood's lamp sorts the toe web quickly.
